greeting.text: Charlotte Roselei, Blue Rose. Do not stare. State your business or leave.
Hmph. Another delver. Keep your distance and your hands to yourself, and we will get along.
You are not unbearable. That is rare. Go on, speak.
You are the one clearing the guardian floors? ...Fine. I suppose that earns you a place within arm's reach.
Back again? Do not make a habit of it. ...Do.

hint.text: Thorns exist so that nobody has to apologise for what they protect. Remember that when you build a defence.
A trap you have seen is half-defused. The dungeon is full of them. Look at the floor before you step on it.
Briars bind what they touch. Fire frees you, so does a sharp blade, so does patience. Panic is the only thing that does not.
If you happen to meet the Black Bulls' captain, you did not hear my name from me.
Take your party's weakest member seriously. A chain breaks at its smallest link, and a squad at its most careless knight.
Noise and light draw things in the dark. Walk softly through halls you have not cleared.
No champions beaten. Listen: start with the lesser ones, watch their habits, then strike. That is what a Blue Rose does.
The Eye of the Midnight Sun hide behind pretty speeches. Cut through them.
One of the Eye's thorns is pulled. Do not celebrate; there are more.
Spade Kingdom blood magic is petty and cruel. Keep your guard up and your party close.
Lucius turns people into props on his stage. I would very much like to prune him.
More challengers from other worlds. Good. I have been told I am unsociable; this is my chance to be rude to strangers.

farewell.text: Mind my roses on your way out.
